model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the "effect" (y-axis) of various language models across different language families (x-axis). The x-axis lists language families in the following order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The y-axis, labeled "effect," is scaled linearly from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language family has a group of six bars, each representing a different language model: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red), as indicated in the legend. Error bars are present on each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The bars are not sorted by height within each group; instead, they are arranged according to the model order in the legend. For most language families, the effect values are relatively low (below 10), with notable exceptions in IE-Indic and Semitic, where some models show effects exceeding 20. In IE-Indic, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ achieve the highest effects (around 20–22), while in Semitic, XLM-B₂ reaches approximately 20. In contrast, the Uralic and Isolate families show minimal effects across all models, with most bars near 0. The chart does not highlight any specific bars with additional visual emphasis.
